name: alien-shooter-web
description: Browser-based multiplayer port of Alien Shooter using Phaser 3 and Node.js

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --workspace=client && npm install --workspace=server && npm install --workspace=shared
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=client && npm run build --workspace=server
scripts.clean: npm run clean --workspace=client && npm run clean --workspace=server && npm run clean --workspace=shared
